Resolves #19541

#19542 removed the last callers of the main-thread `DragDrop` addon's window-drag park, and this deletes it. Gone are `parkWindowDrag`, the addon's `resumeWindowDrag`, park and orphan recovery, the `windowDragPark*` state, and the parked branches of the methods that stay. What remains is the pointer-follow that in-window and tear-out drags use: `startWindowDrag` and the window move in `onDragMove`. `DragDrop.mjs` shrinks from 2,055 to 901 lines and leaves the file-size baseline. No behaviour change.

Evidence: L2/L3 (unit plus headless e2e) → L3 required (AC-2's Workstation and dashboard e2e folders). The native title-bar arms that need a headed wide display skip at their unchanged environment gates when run headless. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | A census at head `5f1b24f2fb` finds no `parkWindowDrag`, `windowDragPark*`, park recovery or orphan recovery in `DragDrop.mjs`, and a grep of `src`, `apps`, `examples` and `test` finds no reference elsewhere. The App-worker `resumeWindowDrag` on the sort zones and `DragCoordinator` is a different, live surface and stays. |
| AC-2 | The kept `DragDrop.spec` arms run in CI `unit`. Locally the full unit suite gives 4,835 passed and 2 skipped. The Workstation and dashboard e2e folders are under Test Evidence. |
| AC-3 | `file-size-baseline.json` drops the `DragDrop.mjs` row. `check-file-sizes --base origin/dev` reports 0 violations. |

## Deltas from ticket

The `Workspace.spec` and `DemoBWorkspace.spec` fakes that stubbed the deleted addon members are removed with them, and so is `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL`'s idle check of `windowDragParked`.

The live pointer-follow move keeps a rejection handler. The deleted park tracking had held the only one, and `Main.windowMoveTo` rejects when a native accessor throws. A `DragDrop.spec` arm covers a refused move.

## Test Evidence

E2E, Workstation and dashboard folders at `6e2cee1902` (the later `5f1b24f2fb` only adds the move's rejection handler), with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set to a Brain checkout at `e74cd6fd`: 180 passed, 4 skipped, 3 failed. That is 187 tests, the same as #19542's run. The three reds are the baseline reds #19542 recorded at the same tree (`dev` `6c1e478f9d` is tree-identical to #19542's head `55e96a3122`):

- `WorkstationNestedColumnResizeNL` › "both stacked panes follow a real outer resize…"
- `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL` › "a human dock action then a popup move…"
- `WorkstationTearOutSourceContinuityNL` › `#16756` "no-drag native place-cycle…". This one is a test settle gate, handled by #19549 / PR #19550.

`WorkstationFilmTourNL` at merge head `ad70fa9a75`: 3/3. That head carries #19546's journey scene, which drives the window-drag path this PR touches.
